LanguageData.LP_BardicPower.label: inspiration power
LanguageData.LP_BardicPower.description: Bard ability power multiplier: 0.5 + (the higher of Social and Artistic level) / 20, plus adventurer Charisma modifier × 0.10 and proficiency bonus, +5% for each level the combined bard-type class levels exceed 1 (up to +95%). Legendary "Undying Legend" +20%. Spells learned through Magical Secrets also use this power.
